package com.aidentx.iam.access_roles_management.model.dto.response; import java.util.UUID; /** * User-friendly entitlement drilldown row for a specific role member assignment. * *

This DTO is intentionally focused on the entitlement list shown after a * user expands a member in the role-members screen. It hides low-level closure * fields such as raw depth/path arrays and instead returns clearer display * fields for inheritance and path context.

* *

The {@code assignmentStatus} field indicates whether this entitlement is * actually provisioned to the identity's accounts:

*
    *
  • {@code ASSIGNED} — entitlement row exists in entitlement_assignments table
    • *
  • {@code PENDING_NO_ACCOUNT} — identity has no account on the target application
    • *
  • {@code NOT_ASSIGNED} — account exists but entitlement not yet provisioned
    • *
*/ public record AccessRoleMemberEntitlementResponse( UUID entitlementId, String entitlementName, UUID applicationId, String applicationName, String accessPathType, String accessPathLabel, UUID childRoleId, String childRoleName, String inheritanceDepthLabel, String assignmentPath, String assignmentStatus, String assignmentStatusReason ) { }
